questions.question: Which king issued a decree allowing the Jews to return and rebuild the temple?
What did Cyrus return to the exiles for the temple?
options: Fine cedar timber brought down from the great forests of Lebanon
An armed escort made up of many well-armed Persian soldiers
The vessels of the house of the LORD taken by Nebuchadnezzar
A whole treasury of gold coins to help fund the work
questions.answer: The vessels of the house of the LORD taken by Nebuchadnezzar

questions.question: The LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus to fulfill the word spoken by Jeremiah.

The treasurer Mithredath counted out the vessels to _____ the prince of Judah.
